hhc_connect.label: Connect HeaterCooler
hhc_connect.description: Open the HHC daisy chain and register its units (returns firmware/temp/verification).

hhc_get_status.label: Get HeaterCooler Status
hhc_get_status.description: Return temperature, time-remaining and control state per unit.

hhc_hold_temp_for_time.label: Hold Temp For Time
hhc_hold_temp_for_time.description: Hold the unit(s) at a target temperature for a number of minutes.

hhc_identify.label: Identify HeaterCooler
hhc_identify.description: Blink the display so an operator can locate the unit(s).

hhc_self_diagnostic.label: Self Diagnostic
hhc_self_diagnostic.description: Read the self-diagnostic toggle, or set it first when 'enable' is given.

hhc_set_display.label: Set Display
hhc_set_display.description: Turn the display on/off and/or set brightness (0-100%).

hhc_start_temp_control.label: Start Temp Control
hhc_start_temp_control.description: Drive the unit(s) to a target temperature (0-110 C).

hhc_stop_temp_control.label: Stop Temp Control
hhc_stop_temp_control.description: Stop temperature control on the unit(s).

hhc_terminate.label: Terminate HeaterCooler Connection
hhc_terminate.description: Disconnect every HeaterCooler unit and release the connection.

hhc_wait_for_temp_control.label: Wait For Temp Control
hhc_wait_for_temp_control.description: Block until the unit(s) reach their temperature band.

hhs_create_star_device.label: Create HHS STAR Device
hhs_create_star_device.description: Register a heater-shaker device attached via the STAR node.

hhs_create_usb_device.label: Create HHS USB Device
hhs_create_usb_device.description: Register a heater-shaker device attached via USB.

hhs_get_device_ids.label: Get HHS Device IDs
hhs_get_device_ids.description: Return all registered heater-shaker device IDs.

hhs_get_status.label: Get HHS Status
hhs_get_status.description: Return the status of all heater-shaker devices.

hhs_set_plate_lock.label: Set Plate Lock
hhs_set_plate_lock.description: Lock/unlock the plate on a device (all devices if none specified).

hhs_start_shaker.label: Start Shaker
hhs_start_shaker.description: Start shaking at the given speed.

hhs_start_temp_control.label: Start Temp Control
hhs_start_temp_control.description: Start temperature control at the given setpoint.

hhs_terminate.label: Terminate HHS Connection
hhs_terminate.description: Disconnect all HHS devices and release the connection.

hhs_wait_for_temp_control.label: Wait For Temp Control
hhs_wait_for_temp_control.description: Block until temperature control setpoint is reached.

inheco_tec_connect.label: Connect InhecoTEC
inheco_tec_connect.description: Verify a controller answers on the bus and scan its 6 device slots.

inheco_tec_get_identification.label: Get InhecoTEC Identification
inheco_tec_get_identification.description: Read device type, serial number, runtime and calibration date for a slot.

inheco_tec_get_reservoir_status.label: Get InhecoTEC Reservoir Status
inheco_tec_get_reservoir_status.description: Read the reservoir/refill status for a slot.

inheco_tec_get_sensor_values.label: Get InhecoTEC Sensor Value
inheco_tec_get_sensor_values.description: Read one controller housing sensor (0-9; see docs -- replicates an apparent vendor bug).

inheco_tec_get_shaker_status.label: Get InhecoTEC Shaker Status
inheco_tec_get_shaker_status.description: Read shaker run status, revolutions and shape for a slot.

inheco_tec_get_temperature_status.label: Get InhecoTEC Temperature Status
inheco_tec_get_temperature_status.description: Read actual/target temperature, limits and heater status for a slot.

inheco_tec_send_command.label: Send Raw InhecoTEC Command
inheco_tec_send_command.description: Send a raw ASCII command string and return the raw response (escape hatch).

inheco_tec_set_shaker_revolutions.label: Set InhecoTEC Shaker Revolutions
inheco_tec_set_shaker_revolutions.description: Set shaker speed in RPM (60-3000, or 0 to clamp without shaking).

inheco_tec_set_target_temperature.label: Set InhecoTEC Target Temperature
inheco_tec_set_target_temperature.description: Set the target temperature (degC) for a slot.

inheco_tec_set_touchscreen.label: Set InhecoTEC Touchscreen
inheco_tec_set_touchscreen.description: Turn the controller's own touchscreen on/off.

inheco_tec_start_temperature_control.label: Start InhecoTEC Temperature Control
inheco_tec_start_temperature_control.description: Start heating/cooling toward the target for a slot.

inheco_tec_stop_temperature_control.label: Stop InhecoTEC Temperature Control
inheco_tec_stop_temperature_control.description: Stop temperature control for a slot.

inheco_tec_terminate.label: Terminate InhecoTEC Connection
inheco_tec_terminate.description: Disconnect every InhecoTEC controller and release the connection.

media_fill_connect.label: Connect Media Fill Module
media_fill_connect.description: Connect and initialize the module on a COM port (returns device id and firmware).

media_fill_disconnect.label: Disconnect Media Fill Module
media_fill_disconnect.description: Disconnect one module; its active pumps stop.

media_fill_fill_trough.label: Fill Trough
media_fill_fill_trough.description: Start a pump; it runs until the trough's sensor triggers or the timeout elapses.

media_fill_get_device_ids.label: Get Media Fill Device IDs
media_fill_get_device_ids.description: List connected modules: device id, COM port, firmware.

media_fill_get_last_error_message.label: Get Last Error Message
media_fill_get_last_error_message.description: Read the vendor driver's last error message.

media_fill_get_liquid_level_sensor_state.label: Get Liquid Level Sensor
media_fill_get_liquid_level_sensor_state.description: 0 = liquid not detected; 1 = liquid detected, sensor unplugged, or controller off.

media_fill_get_pump_direction.label: Get Pump Direction
media_fill_get_pump_direction.description: Read a pump's motor direction (0 counter-clockwise, 1 clockwise).

media_fill_get_status.label: Get Media Fill Status
media_fill_get_status.description: Firmware, every pump's direction and sensor, and the last error message (read-only).

media_fill_set_pump_direction.label: Set Pump Direction
media_fill_set_pump_direction.description: Set a pump's motor direction. Every pump starts each run counter-clockwise.

media_fill_stop_pump.label: Stop Pump
media_fill_stop_pump.description: Stop one pump and keep the module connected (2.0 library only).

media_fill_wait_for_pump.label: Wait For Pump
media_fill_wait_for_pump.description: Block until the pump has finished pumping.

media_fill_waste_pump_no_sensor.label: Pump Out (No Sensor)
media_fill_waste_pump_no_sensor.description: Run the pump in reverse of its set (fill) direction, ignoring the sensor, for the full timeout (max 20 s with the 2.0 library, 720 s with 1.1).

odtc_abort.label: Abort ODTC
odtc_abort.description: Abort the in-progress method on the unit.

odtc_connect.label: Connect ODTC
odtc_connect.description: Register one ODTC unit and lock it for this connection (returns firmware/serial/state).

odtc_get_device_ids.label: Get ODTC Device IDs
odtc_get_device_ids.description: Return the device_id of every currently registered ODTC unit.

odtc_get_run_data.label: Get ODTC Run Data
odtc_get_run_data.description: Return the run-data log for the unit's most recent (or in-progress) run.

odtc_get_status.label: Get ODTC Status
odtc_get_status.description: Return state / locked / door-open per unit.

odtc_get_temperature.label: Get ODTC Temperature
odtc_get_temperature.description: Return block + lid temperature per unit.

odtc_pause.label: Pause ODTC
odtc_pause.description: Pause the in-progress method on the unit.

odtc_resume.label: Resume ODTC
odtc_resume.description: Resume a paused method on the unit.

odtc_run_protocol.label: Run ODTC Protocol (file)
odtc_run_protocol.description: Upload and run a PCR protocol from a vendor-authored MethodSet XML file.

odtc_stop_method.label: Stop ODTC Method
odtc_stop_method.description: Stop the in-progress method on the unit.

odtc_terminate.label: Terminate All ODTC Units
odtc_terminate.description: Unlock and disconnect every registered ODTC unit.

odtc_terminate_device.label: Terminate ODTC Unit
odtc_terminate_device.description: Unlock and disconnect one ODTC unit.

odtc_wait_for_protocol.label: Wait For ODTC Protocol
odtc_wait_for_protocol.description: Block until the unit's in-progress protocol run completes.

tilt_module_connect.label: Connect Tilt Module System
tilt_module_connect.description: Open the COM port for a system (1200 baud, 8E1). Call once per system, before initializing.

tilt_module_error_message.label: Tilt Module Error Text
tilt_module_error_message.description: Text for a Tilt Module return code (firmware 0..7, communication -1..-11).

tilt_module_get_status.label: Get Tilt Module Status
tilt_module_get_status.description: Initialized/powered state, firmware and the last commanded angle (the module has no position read-back).

module_name.label: Module Name
module_name.help: The module's two-character name on the chain (hamilton-tilt-module --probe COMn reports it).

tilt_module_initialize.label: Initialize Tilt Module
tilt_module_initialize.description: Reset the error state, home the module to horizontal and read its firmware version.

module_name.label: Module Name
module_name.help: The module's two-character name on the chain (hamilton-tilt-module --probe COMn reports it).

tilt_module_move_to_position.label: Move Tilt Module
tilt_module_move_to_position.description: Tilt the module to 0-10 whole degrees (0 = horizontal; the right side lifts) and wait for it. Follow with Tilt Labware at the same angle so VENUS pipettes into the tilted wells.

module_name.label: Module Name
module_name.help: The module's two-character name on the chain (hamilton-tilt-module --probe COMn reports it).

tilt_module_terminate_communication.label: Disconnect Tilt Module System
tilt_module_terminate_communication.description: Close a system's COM port. Terminate every module on it first.

tilt_module_terminate_module.label: Terminate Tilt Module
tilt_module_terminate_module.description: Return the module to horizontal, then power it off (not powered off if it cannot return).

module_name.label: Module Name
module_name.help: The module's two-character name on the chain (hamilton-tilt-module --probe COMn reports it).

wxs_get_weight.label: Get Weight
wxs_get_weight.description: Get a stable or dynamic weight value from the balance.

wxs_initialize_balance.label: Initialize Balance
wxs_initialize_balance.description: Establish a connection to the WXS balance.

wxs_internal_calibration.label: Internal Calibration
wxs_internal_calibration.description: Start an internal adjustment (calibration) procedure on the balance.

wxs_set_scale_parameters.label: Set Scale Parameters
wxs_set_scale_parameters.description: Set general balance parameters (weighing mode, vibration, stability, weight unit, auto zero).

wxs_set_zero.label: Set Zero
wxs_set_zero.description: Set a new zero point on the balance, clearing the tare memory.

wxs_tare.label: Tare
wxs_tare.description: Tare the balance and return the tare weight change.

wxs_terminate_balance.label: Terminate Balance
wxs_terminate_balance.description: Terminate the connection to the balance.
